ruleSet.predicate: For a frozen dataset manifest the returned defect set equals the expected defect set as (feature identity, check name, geometry part) triples; requested checks are a subset of the tool's declared supported checks; minimumSegmentLength, when supplied, is echoed with its unit source; undeclared CRS or XY tolerance yields UNKNOWN/BLOCKED, never PASS.
ruleSet.recompute: Build the returned defect triple set and the frozen expected set; assert set equality in both directions; assert every count field equals the length of its own defect list; assert an unsupported check name returns a refusal rather than an empty defect list.
ruleSet.choiceBasis: FINAL requires quality assertions to be frozen before results but publishes no defect-set vocabulary; set equality with fail-closed UNKNOWN is the D-089 choice.

ruleSet.predicate: rules[] is a subset of the frozen topology-rule manifest for the dataset; per-rule violation counts equal frozen expected counts; clusterTolerance is reported together with its declared source; an unknown rule name is refused, not silently skipped; error geometry is produced only for rules that can be evaluated on the dataset's geometry type.
ruleSet.recompute: Compare per-rule violation counts against the frozen expected-count map key by key; assert the union of per-rule violation identities equals the returned overall violation set; assert an unknown rule returns a refusal whose message names the rule.
ruleSet.choiceBasis: FINAL names topology checks as quality work but does not enumerate rule sets; the per-rule expected-count map is the D-089 choice.

ruleSet.predicate: With keyFields declared, the added/deleted/modified partitions are mutually exclusive and their union equals the frozen expected delta; compareGeometry=true requires a tolerance bound to the declared XY tolerance of both inputs, otherwise BLOCKED; a maxFeatures cut is reported as truncated and never as equality; duplicate key values are reported, not collapsed.
ruleSet.recompute: Assert pairwise disjointness of the three partitions and equality of their union with the frozen expected delta; assert the truncation flag equals (returned feature count == maxFeatures); recompute geometry equality only where tolerance is declared and echo it back.
ruleSet.choiceBasis: Partition disjointness plus explicit truncation is the D-089 way to make version comparison recomputable without inventing FINAL numeric thresholds.
sourceRefs: D-088 range note: detect_geometry_duplicates merged into find_identical

ruleSet.predicate: Field-level equality is asserted on (name, type, length, nullable, domain binding, alias); ignoreOrder=true must not hide a missing or extra field; a domain difference is reported as its own class and never folded into a type difference; geometry-type and spatial-reference identity differences are reported separately from attribute differences.
ruleSet.recompute: Diff the returned schema delta against the frozen expected delta as a set of (field, difference class) pairs; assert both directions; assert ignoreOrder only changes presentation order, verified by set equality with and without the flag.
ruleSet.choiceBasis: The difference-class vocabulary is a D-089 calibration choice.

ruleSet.predicate: Every constraint in constraints[] is echoed with its parse status; violation row identities equal the frozen expected violation set; an unparseable or unsupported constraint reports UNKNOWN with the constraint text and never counts as satisfied; constraints resolved against a domain or subtype name the domain or subtype they resolved against.
ruleSet.recompute: Compare the returned violation identity set with the frozen expected set; assert the per-constraint summary counts equal the partition of that set; assert a deliberately unsupported constraint yields UNKNOWN and not a zero-violation result.
ruleSet.choiceBasis: Constraint-class vocabulary follows the catalog's domain/subtype governance boundary (§2 P2); the exact set is a D-089 choice.

ruleSet.predicate: Alignment is derived from CRS, cell size, origin, extent, band count and pyramid identity compared exactly at the candidate snapTolerance of 0; any of those fields missing yields UNKNOWN; misalignment is quantified as cell-size ratio and origin offset in both units and pixels; a declared reference raster is echoed and every verdict is stated relative to it.
ruleSet.recompute: Recompute the alignment verdict from the reported grid fields and assert it equals the tool verdict for every input raster; assert the frozen expected aligned/misaligned partition; assert a raster with a missing field is UNKNOWN and not aligned.
ruleSet.choiceBasis: snapTolerance candidate default 0 mirrors the frozen M1 raster-grid exactness in comparison-rules-v1 GEO-001; v1 bytes are unchanged and only referenced.

ruleSet.predicate: Returned transformation names are a subset of the host-published transformation set for the (sourceCrs, targetCrs) pair; each candidate carries its area of validity and whether it is the default; no transformation may appear that is not published; an empty candidate list is an explicit empty-with-reason result and downstream reprojection is BLOCKED.
ruleSet.recompute: Intersect the returned names with the host-published list captured in the frozen case manifest and assert equality; assert every row carries areaOfValidity and isDefault; assert a pair with no published candidate returns an empty list plus a reason, not a guessed name.

ruleSet.predicate: The node and edge set equals the frozen dependency manifest for the root within maxDepth; includeBroken=false must not delete broken links from the report silently but reports their count; cycles are reported as cycles instead of recursing; the depth limit is honoured on every branch.
ruleSet.recompute: Compare returned node/edge identity sets with the frozen manifest; assert max depth of every returned path <= maxDepth; assert broken-link count equals the number of edges whose target path does not resolve in the manifest.
ruleSet.choiceBasis: Manifest equality plus explicit broken-edge accounting is the D-089 recomputable form.

ruleSet.predicate: Every lineage node carries sourceIdentity, product or acquisition identity where applicable, method, tool version, units and CRS; a missing provenance field is stated as MISSING with its field name and is never inferred as valid; includeArtifacts=true lists artifact paths whose hashes recompute.
ruleSet.recompute: For each node assert the required field names are present in the response schema and that MISSING is used for absent values; recompute the SHA-256 of each listed D-drive artifact and assert equality with the reported hash.
ruleSet.choiceBasis: Field list follows the G-205 provenance-field form already frozen for TS08; applying it generally is a D-089 choice.

ruleSet.predicate: mode is one of attributes, geometry, attributes+geometry; geometry mode requires a declared tolerance; duplicate groups partition the tested rows so that (sum of group sizes - group count) equals the duplicate excess count; a row cannot appear in two groups of the same mode; the merged find_identical contract is the only duplicate-detection surface, since detect_geometry_duplicates was folded into it and has no separate implementation.
ruleSet.recompute: Recompute group partition arithmetic from the returned groups; assert the duplicate excess count matches; assert mode switching never creates a new unnamed mode; assert a zero-tolerance geometry run reports its tolerance source.
ruleSet.choiceBasis: The partition arithmetic is a D-089 recomputable formulation of the merged contract.

ruleSet.predicate: reportPath absent means a pure in-memory structured report with zero artifact written; reportPath present means the path resolves on D:, an existing target is refused through the pre-existing OUTPUT_EXISTS gate unless overwrite is explicitly granted, and the write is registered in an artifact manifest with size and hash; read-only mode refuses reportPath. No new error code is introduced: the existing code set stays at 33.
ruleSet.recompute: Diff the run-root file listing before and after a reportPath-absent call and assert it is empty; for a reportPath-present call assert one manifest entry per artifact with recomputable hash; re-issue the call against the existing artifact and assert refusal; set read-only mode and assert reportPath refusal.

ruleSet.toolBinding: set_layout_element_properties, add_layout_text, apply_symbology_from_layer (style application; the saved style artifact itself is a benchmark input)
ruleSet.predicate: Style tokens (font family and size ladder, colour and class scheme, margin set, legend layout, units, north-arrow and scale-bar style) come from an explicitly saved project-style artifact identified by hash; every produced page applies values equal to the saved tokens; a page that silently falls back to defaults while a style is bound fails.
ruleSet.recompute: Read the saved style artifact hash from the case manifest; for each page assert reported token values equal the manifest values; assert the binding is stated per page rather than inferred.
ruleSet.choiceBasis: FINAL Z09 requires an explicitly saved project style but does not enumerate tokens; the token list is the D-089 choice.

ruleSet.predicate: For the ten-page atlas profile the page count, page order, per-page class set, legend entry order, units and source line are identical across pages wherever the brief requires consistency; per-page data values bind to one data fingerprint; a fingerprint change re-validates all pages inside the same job instead of patching pages one by one.
ruleSet.recompute: Assert page count equals the frozen expected count; assert cross-page invariance of the listed fields by set comparison over pages; assert one fingerprint value repeated in every page receipt and a job-level re-validation record after a fingerprint change.

ruleSet.predicate: Each media profile (portrait, landscape, print A4/A3 at 300 DPI, paper, PPT 16:9, long image) is separately verifiable: required semantic slots present, no slot dropped, no text clipped, minimum font floor respected, numeric facts identical across media; reflow may change geometry only, never facts.
ruleSet.recompute: For each declared media profile assert the semantic-slot list equals the template slot list, assert the numeric fact set equals across profiles by exact canonical-decimal comparison, and assert the reported minimum rendered text size >= the frozen font floor.

ruleSet.predicate: Dense text blocks retain every required semantic string; when a user original or external master exists, its hash before and after the job is identical; output is generated as a new revision rather than overwriting the original; fine-grained merge is permitted only inside the explicitly verified scope and the unverified case generates a new version instead; refusal is the correct answer when the merge scope cannot be established.
ruleSet.recompute: Recompute the original master hash before and after and assert equality; assert the produced output path is a new revision directory; assert dense-text semantic strings equal the frozen expected string set; assert an unverified merge scope yields a refusal whose reason names the scope.
sourceRefs: GATE-G207 rulings on overwrite and revision semantics

ruleSet.predicate: Every number, unit, category label and source note in a report or PPTX deliverable equals the corresponding value in the map or analysis fact table for the same revision, compared exactly at canonical decimal precision; an unreferenced number with no fact-table source fails; the map and report deliverable pair carries one revision id.
ruleSet.recompute: Extract the numeric and label sets from both deliverables and assert set equality plus revision-id equality; assert each deliverable number traces to a fact-table row id; assert the source note strings equal across deliverables.
ruleSet.choiceBasis: FINAL requires same-source report/PPTX numbers to agree but does not define the extraction set; canonical-decimal set equality is the D-089 choice.
